headline: Paraguayan Guaraní Surge Pressures Farm Exporters Amid Exchange Rate Shifts
summary: A US dollar buys about 14% fewer Paraguayan guaraníes than at the end of 2025, with the grain exporters' chamber reporting that farmers are absorbing the cost.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations directly impact the profit margins and export competitiveness of agricultural producers in export-driven emerging economies.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Appreciation of the domestic currency reduces local currency revenues for dollar-denominated agricultural exports.
